about_the_game:
Embody divine grace and healing power with sacred relics and blessed armor.

The Priest Equipment Package for 4Story: The Original equips faithful protectors and spiritual warriors with powerful tools to heal allies, banish darkness, and uphold the will of the divine. Whether you serve as a radiant healer or a holy avenger, this set grants you the strength to guide and defend.

Includes the following exclusive holy items:

  • Mysterious Magic Wand – A holy conduit that enhances healing spells and support incantations with refined focus and speed.

  • Mysterious Magic Staff – A staff imbued with divine energy, ideal for channeling protective auras and powerful blessings.

  • Mysterious Magic Book – A sacred tome inscribed with prayers and spells, boosting casting efficiency and divine spell power.

Blessed Man Armor Set:

  • Blessed Man Helm

  • Blessed Man Chest

  • Blessed Man Leggings

  • Blessed Man Gloves

  • Blessed Man Boots

A ceremonial armor set infused with divine light, offering resilience, enhanced spirit regeneration, and protection against unholy forces.

Answer the call of the gods and become the beacon of hope your allies need. The Priest Equipment Package is your divine arsenal in the world of 4Story: The Original.

*You must enter the game, open the premium shop and click on the DLC banner to receive the set item.
